landing.title: Understand what your pet is trying to tell you.
landing.subtitle: PeloNaRoupa combines AI-assisted behavior interpretation with your observations to create explanations that improve over time.
landing.valueProp: Clear explanations. Better understanding. Built together with pet owners.
landing.step1Desc: Record your pet's barks, meows, or other sounds directly in the application.
landing.step2Desc: Our advanced models classify the emotional state in real time based on sound.
landing.step3Desc: View reports, well-being trends, and share the profile with your family.
landing.feat1Desc: Interprets behavior and vocalizations to provide a clearer sense of what an animal may be trying to communicate.
landing.feat2Desc: Rate how accurate an analysis felt, logging corrections to refine future explanations over time.
landing.feat3Desc: A dedicated review area for admins and vets to verify and moderate user-submitted corrections.
landing.feat4Desc: Visualize emotional evolution, track baseline deviations, and export observations.
landing.feat5Desc: All interpretations act as a helpful second opinion, never a medical or veterinary diagnosis.
landing.disclaimerDesc: PeloNaRoupa uses the YAMNet model (a generic audio event classifier) to estimate emotional states as behavioral approximations. Results should be interpreted as signals or cues — never as a diagnosis. This application does not replace professional veterinary evaluation.
